description: Tender for the Supply of 5,000,000 Vials of Cefuroxime Sodium for Injection BP 750mg
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender for a total cost of US $1,285,000.00 (LKR 140,825,000.00), was approved by the Cabinet.
